provenance.source: heygen-com/experiment-framework PR #55246 (synchronous /v3/audio/music on Lyria 3 Pro); live canary calls through the HyperFrames Desktop key proxy on 2026-10-07
provenance.kind: PR-and-live-call-derived structural contract; route hidden from public docs
notes: Synchronous: one POST generates the track; GET /v3/audio/music/{id} re-reads it with a fresh 1 h signed audio_url.
Idempotency-Key is required; the same key with a different body is 409, a duplicate while running is 409 request_in_progress, a replay returns the same job without a new charge.

Auth: x-api-key (OAuth tokens get 403 api_key_required) with assets:write / assets:read. Charged per song to HeyGen API credits before the model runs; refunded on failure. 402 when the balance cannot cover one song.
duration_seconds is a target: longer renders are trimmed with a fade, shorter ones are kept; the response reports the measured duration_seconds. There is no tier below 30 s.
Response data: id, status, model, created_at, requested_duration_seconds, duration_seconds, audio_url, format (mp3). Errors include content_policy_violation (400), 502/504 vendor outage or timeout.
